description: MUTATES Autumn billing data — fetches a customer by id, creating them if they do not exist. Autumn API: POST /v1/customers.get_or_create.

create_in_stripe.description: Whether to create the customer in Stripe.

currency.description: Currency to bill this customer in (e.g. usd, eur).

customer_id.description: Your unique identifier for the customer (null to create an anonymous customer).

expand.description: Related data to expand, e.g. invoices, entities, subscriptions.plan, purchases.plan, balances.feature.

fingerprint.description: Unique identifier to detect duplicate customers / prevent free-trial abuse.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata for the customer.

stripe_id.description: Existing Stripe customer id, if any.

name: get_or_create_customer
title: Get or create a customer
